ui_scope: Adds selected Sun/Moon directional markers tied to live/simulated time; preserves adaptive landscape scroller and centred dock
ui_changes: portrait mode uses a horizontal glowing circular-thumb slider
landscape mode uses a vertical slider on the right side, with +12h at the top and −12h at the bottom to match upward-forward movement
slider input uses a fixed simulation anchor so drag values map consistently to time
Sun/Moon tracker icon starts inactive and panel stays closed on launch
controls remain above the bottom safe-area inset
changes: Render a directionally calculated Sun marker when Sun tracking is selected.
Render a directionally calculated Moon marker with approximate phase illumination when Moon tracking is selected.
Synchronize Cesium scene clock to live time and selected ±12-hour simulation time.
Keep the existing 40-degree Moon visibility overlay threshold.
Keep the marker distances visually scaled for the existing globe camera; do not claim scale-accurate orbital distances.
Preserve the v1.32 centre dock and responsive landscape scroller.
Requires on-device interaction and visual testing; no runtime validation claim.
title: EARTH // LIVE — Sun & Moon Visualization v1.33
description: Adds visible, directionally calculated Sun and Moon markers linked to live time and the existing ±12-hour simulation slider. Includes a simple Moon illumination appearance and keeps the current Moon visibility overlay. Celestial markers are visually scaled for readability; the Moon model is an approximation, not a precision ephemeris. Preserves the centred dock and adaptive landscape scroller. Requires iPhone/PWA testing.
